description: This file defines the ChainLoader class in the Twig templating engine. It implements the LoaderInterface to load templates from multiple underlying loaders, managing cache and error handling for template source retrieval, existence checks, cache keys, and freshness checks.

classes.name: ChainLoader
classes.description: A loader that aggregates multiple other loaders, attempting to load templates from them sequentially.

methods.name: addLoader
methods.description: Adds a new loader to the chain, updating the loader list and clearing the source cache.

methods.name: getLoaders
methods.description: Returns the array of loaders used by the chain, converting from iterable if necessary.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Retrieves the source context for a given template name by querying each loader until one finds it.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a template exists in any of the loaders, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Retrieves a cache key for a template, trying each loader in sequence.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if a template is fresh (up-to-date) across the loaders.
